data_description.output_dir: Folder inside Home Assistant's container. Each recording is saved as <folder>/<station>/<show> - <timestamp>.mp3.
data_description.calendar_entity_id: Each event on this calendar is one recording: the summary is the show, the location is the station name (or a stream URL). Leave empty to record only with the record action.
data_description.file_owner: Optional. Change the owner of saved files, e.g. 568:568. Home Assistant's container usually runs as root.
